memory_update.text: CAMT is the strongest US-listed underfollowed discovery candidate for the HBM/AI advanced-packaging yield-enablement lane because official materials map directly to advanced packaging and gathered evidence references orders from a leading HBM manufacturer.

AMKR should be retained as a US-listed reference anchor for advanced packaging capacity, but not treated as the primary underfollowed discovery name because its market cap and attention level are higher.

ENTG maps to the surface-chemistry/materials-handling side of the node, but AI/HBM-specific revenue linkage is currently an inference that must be verified through filings, management commentary, or customer qualification evidence.

Many of the purest substrate and surface-chemistry suppliers cited in the node thesis are not straightforward US-listed small/mid-cap names; later layers should search ADR/OTC availability, Asia listings, customer concentration, liquidity, and governance risk.

COHU remains a speculative shadow candidate until evidence proves exposure to HBM, AI accelerator packages, advanced OSAT customers, or package-level inspection/test bottlenecks rather than broad cyclical semiconductor test demand.

node: HBM and AI accelerator advanced-packaging substrate and surface-chemistry layer
summary: Layer 1B expanded the US-listed universe around the HBM/AI-accelerator advanced-packaging substrate, chemistry, inspection, and yield-enablement layer. The cleanest direct public-market exposure is still limited because many key substrate and chemistry suppliers are Asia-listed or embedded inside larger materials companies. For US-listed names, the best two-lane map is: Amkor as the outsourced advanced-packaging reference anchor, Camtek as a higher-purity inspection/metrology discovery candidate with explicit HBM order signals, Entegris as a larger materials/contamination-control candidate tied to advanced packaging chemistry and substrate handling, and Cohu as a lower-attention inspection/test hypothesis that needs stronger proof of AI/HBM-specific revenue linkage. This is research universe expansion only, not a trading recommendation.
